title: Sesamin exerts protective effects against diquat-induced acute kidney injury by inhibiting oxidative stress, apoptosis and autophagy: A key role for the SIRT5/FOXO3a signaling pathway.
authors: Han, Siying; Pu, Yi; Liu, Zhenning
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芝麻素通过SIRT5/FOXO3a通路缓解百草枯诱导的急性肾损伤，涉及分子对接但核心是细胞凋亡与氧化应激，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题无关。
abstract: Diquat poisoning leads to acute kidney injury (AKI) with a high mortality rate. Sesamin possesses antioxidant, anti-inflammatory and anti-apoptotic properties. However, whether sesamin can protect against diquat-induced AKI remains unclear. This study aimed to investigate whether sesamin can exert protective effects against diquat-induced AKI and its potential molecular mechanisms. Diquat induced reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation, mitochondrial damage, apoptosis, and autophagy in human proximal tubular cells (HK-2 cells). SIRT5, a member of the sirtuin family of NAD + -dependent histone deacetylases, was slightly increased in diquat-exposed HK-2 cells. Additionally, diquat upregulated FOXO3a protein expression, accompanied by decreased acetyl-FOXO3a and enhanced nuclear translocation of FOXO3a in HK-2 cells. The toxic effects of diquat in HK-2 cells were further exacerbated by SIRT5 knockdown, but ameliorated by SIRT5 overexpression. Molecular docking and cellular thermal shift assay indicated that sesamin bound to SIRT5, with PHE70 likely serving as a key binding site. Sesamin attenuated diquat-induced ROS generation, mitochondrial damage, apoptosis, and autophagy in HK-2 cells by activating the SIRT5/FOXO3a pathway. Meanwhile, sesamin significantly attenuated diquat-induced AKI in mice by inhibiting oxidative stress, apoptosis and autophagy. Collectively, oxidative stress, apoptosis, and autophagy are involved in diquat-induced acute kidney injury. SIRT5/FOXO3a signaling pathway contributes to diquat-induced cytotoxicity in renal tubular epithelial cells. Sesamin exerts protective effects against diquat-induced acute kidney injury in mice.
abstract_zh: 敌草快中毒可导致急性肾损伤（AKI），其死亡率较高。芝麻素具有抗氧化、抗炎和抗凋亡特性。然而，芝麻素是否能保护免受敌草快诱导的AKI尚不清楚。本研究旨在探讨芝麻素是否能对敌草快诱导的AKI发挥保护作用及其潜在分子机制。敌草快在人近端肾小管细胞（HK-2细胞）中诱导了活性氧（ROS）生成、线粒体损伤、凋亡和自噬。SIRT5，作为NAD+依赖性组蛋白去乙酰化酶sirtuin家族的一员，在暴露于敌草快的HK-2细胞中略有增加。此外，敌草快上调了FOXO3a蛋白表达，伴随乙酰化FOXO3a减少及FOXO3a核转位增强。SIRT5敲低进一步加剧了敌草快在HK-2细胞中的毒性效应，而SIRT5过表达则改善了这些效应。分子对接和细胞热位移实验表明，芝麻素与SIRT5结合，PHE70可能作为关键结合位点。芝麻素通过激活SIRT5/FOXO3a通路，减轻了敌草快诱导的HK-2细胞中ROS生成、线粒体损伤、凋亡和自噬。同时，芝麻素通过抑制氧化应激、凋亡和自噬，显著减轻了小鼠中敌草快诱导的AKI。综上所述，氧化应激、凋亡和自噬参与敌草快诱导的急性肾损伤。SIRT5/FOXO3a信号通路有助于敌草快诱导的肾小管上皮细胞毒性。芝麻素对小鼠中敌草快诱导的急性肾损伤发挥保护作用。
